name: MLIR: Multi-Level Intermediate Representation
notes:
MLIR (Multi-Level Intermediate Representation) is a compiler infrastructure project for building reusable and extensible compiler infrastructure. Hosted at mlir.llvm.org. Provides a hybrid IR that supports multiple abstraction levels, from dataflow graphs to high-performance computing optimizations. Used by TensorFlow, Triton, IREE, and other ML compilers.
